skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and apply concepts, nature, and roles of Public Relations in English and Vietnamese, including definitions, marketing environment, customer behavior, strategies, tools, and practical terms.
Understand diverse global work environments, cultural similarities and differences, and professional ethics and expectations in Public Relations.
Collaborate effectively with team members to complete tasks in English.
Communicate, read, write, and present in English for Public Relations tasks.
Understand and apply ethical considerations and professional codes of conduct in Public Relations.
Conduct research and analyze data for Public Relations activities.
Understand and implement the Public Relations process, including planning, execution, and evaluation.
Analyze situations, identify problems/opportunities, and develop solutions in Public Relations.
